name: empty
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::empty.memory_format(SymInt[] size, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None, MemoryFormat? memory_format=None) -> Tensor. Allocates fresh uninitialized storage; element values are intentionally undefined and the correctness suite therefore validates shape, stride, dtype, layout, device, element count and requires-grad metadata only. It covers default dtype, floating, integer, boolean and complex dtypes, zero-size dimensions and higher-rank shapes. Pure uninitialized allocation is classified as metadata/runtime work rather than required computation.
